Use a 6–8 digit PIN or biometric authentication (fingerprint/face). Avoid simple patterns or birthdays. Enable "Screen timeout" to lock after 30 seconds of inactivity.

3. **Install Trusted Security Apps**  
Download only reputable apps (e.g., Google Authenticator, Bitwarden) from official app stores. Avoid third-party "security" apps with unknown developers.

Enable automatic updates for OS, apps, and security patches. Updates fix known vulnerabilities hackers exploit.

Set a strong password (mix of letters, numbers, symbols) for your device. Avoid reusing passwords across accounts.

6. **Enable Two-Factor Authentication (2FA)**  
For all major accounts (email, banking, social media), turn on 2FA using authenticator apps or trusted devices. Never use SMS-only 2FA—vulnerable to SIM swapping.

When using public networks, use a virtual private network (VPN) like ProtonVPN or ExpressVPN. Never log into banking or email on unsecured networks.

Use a trusted antivirus (e.g., Norton, Bitdefender). Review app permissions—disable access to contacts, location, or camera for apps you don’t need.

9. **Monitor for Suspicious Activity**  
Check login history in your account settings. If you see unfamiliar logins, change passwords immediately and enable alerts.
